source: Layer E plus Golden Theme variant tournament against the long-distance reference format and Calm Enough For Your Chaos first principles.
selector_verdict: Winner keeps the chat-bubble reference mechanic but deepens it into a relationship truth: long distance hurts most in the boring, ordinary life they cannot waste together. The proof beats are small, drawable, and sendable; Zuv's role is active because he replies, joins, and lets each tiny plan matter.
calm_enough_for_chaos_alignment: Preserves the gold-machine lesson by starting with a universal ache, proving it through playful Aachu/Zuv behavior, showing Zuv joining the ordinary future instead of treating it as silly, and landing a tender acceptance thesis.
screenplay_pattern: distance ache -> tiny future plans -> banter receipts -> shared wish underneath -> ordinary-time payoff
final_public_slide_copy_direction: If there was no long distance...

"We should cook together."
"That's a terrible idea."
"Exactly."

"Board game night?"
"Only if you don't invent rules after losing."

"Cab is 12 minutes late."
"Best news all day."

"Maybe I don't miss big dates."
"Maybe I just miss wasting normal time with you."

candidates.name: Ordinary Time With You
candidates.universal_truth: If there were no long distance, the romance would be the tiny normal things they finally get to waste together.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu turns imaginary plans into pure private-text banter: cooking badly, board games, and being happy that the cab is late.
candidates.concrete_proof: The message thread keeps cutting to tiny imagined scenes they cannot do in the same room yet, with the emotion hidden under teasing replies.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv answers every small plan like it matters and lets the boring thing become a love language.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe I just miss wasting normal time with you.

candidates.name: We Don't Miss Dates. We Miss Tuesdays.
candidates.universal_truth: The ache of distance is not always missing special plans; it is missing the tiny unspecial rituals.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu names small plans with dramatic seriousness.
candidates.concrete_proof: Cooking, board-game competitiveness, and delayed-cab relief.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv joins the silly future tense instead of dismissing it.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love is wanting the same boring day.

candidates.name: The Plans Were Tiny
candidates.universal_truth: When two people are apart, tiny plans become proof that the relationship still has a room to live in.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu collects tiny plans like future receipts.
candidates.concrete_proof: The phone thread becomes a kitchen, a game board, and a rainy cab wait.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv keeps the imaginary room open by replying with warmth.
candidates.tender_thesis: The smallest plans can hold the biggest missing.

candidates.name: The Cab Can Be Late
candidates.universal_truth: Sometimes the most romantic thing is not arriving fast; it is getting a few extra minutes together.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu secretly hopes the cab is late because leaving hurts.
candidates.concrete_proof: Rain, umbrella, phone glow, and both people quietly glad about the delay.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv admits the same soft wish instead of playing practical.
candidates.tender_thesis: Some delays are just love buying time.

candidates.name: Board Games Across A Phone
candidates.universal_truth: Couples in distance still fight, tease, and keep score over ordinary things they cannot do yet.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's competitive softness turns a board game into a future scene.
candidates.concrete_proof: A board-game table imagined underneath the chat bubbles.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv teases her gently while keeping the shared future alive.
candidates.tender_thesis: Missing someone can look like planning a fight you want to have.
